   City of South Gate
  Tweedy Mile Advisory Board
  July 24, 2023

  STAFF REPORT
  AGENDA ITEM NO. 1

TO: Tweedy Mile Advisory Board

FROM: Giselle M. Hernandez, Acting Management Analyst, City Manager’s Office

SUBJECT: Update on the Marketing Services for the Tweedy Mile Business Improvement District

PURPOSE: To provide the Tweedy Mile Advisory Board with an update on the marketing services for
the Tweedy Mile Business Improvement District (“Tweedy Mile”).

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and File.

BACKGROUND: The Tweedy Mile Advisory Board and the City Council approved $40,000 for marketing
services in the Fiscal Year 2022-23 budget. Staff engaged the services of Tripepi Smith to assist in creating
a long-term set of assets including an outreach campaign to drive interest to the Tweedy Mile. The
branding has been completed with a new logo that reflects the Tweedy Mile business façade. A video
featuring the new tagline “This is Tweedy Mile” highlights older and newer businesses on the mile and
invites people to shop and dine locally. A stock photoshoot and video shoot have also been completed
and include footage from the annual Tweedy Mile Street Fair. The new Tweedy Mile website is ready to
launch with a full directory of Tweedy Mile businesses, photos of business owners and newly released
interviews with business owners on the Tweedy Mile. During the next few months, the public will see new
social media posts highlighting Tweedy Mile, as well as printed marketing materials including brochures
and a map of the businesses.
